name: Succubus

source.note: The 2024 Succubus (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block). Draining Kiss lowers Hit Point maximum on a success as well as a failure; only the failure is entered. Charm is Dominate Person cast at level 8.

traits.name: Incubus Form
traits.summary: After a Long Rest it can take the Incubus stat block instead.
traits.text: When the succubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into an Incubus and use that stat block instead of this one. What it wears or carries doesn't change.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: A Fiendish Touch, then Charm or Draining Kiss.

actions.name: Fiendish Touch
actions.summary: A caress that burns the mind.

actions.name: Charm
actions.summary: Casts Dominate Person at level 8 (Cha, DC 15).
actions.text: The succubus casts Dominate Person (level 8 version), needing no components and using Charisma (spell save DC 15).

actions.name: Draining Kiss
actions.summary: DC 15 Con save by a Charmed creature within 5 ft: 3d8 Psychic (half on a success) and its Hit Point maximum drops by the damage taken.
actions.text: Constitution saving throw, DC 15, one creature Charmed by the succubus within 5 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. Success: half damage. Failure or success: the target's Hit Point maximum decreases by the damage it took.

bonus_actions.name: Shape-Shift
bonus_actions.summary: Takes the form of a Small or Medium Humanoid, or returns to its true form (Fly Speed only in its true form).

shapes.name: Small or Medium Humanoid
shapes.summary: A Small or Medium Humanoid: statistics unchanged, but no Fly Speed.

summary: A flying tempter that dominates the unwary and drains the maximum Hit Points of those it charms.
